edition_comparison.second_edition_notice: Corrects the last-column values of Table 1 on printed page 9; Appendix A is not an independent second analysis.

appendix_A.purpose: Uncertainty of litter-input time series on mineral soils, updated through 2023 with Repola et al. (2025) biomass models.
model_and_sampling_components: NFI sampling covariance of BCEF and stem-volume estimators (A5)

printed_examples.A2: Pine model 2b parameter example; diagonal U(%) and off-diagonal correlations
printed_examples.A5: One NFI13 sampling region; above-ground BCEF/stem-volume U(%)/correlations

appendix_A.full_matrices_described_but_not_printed: Corresponding matrices including below-ground components were estimated separately for every VMI8-VMI13 cycle and sampling region on each Monte Carlo iteration; harvest-removal and natural-mortality BCEF matrices were also estimated.
appendix_A.algorithm_steps_5_to_7: Estimate BCEF/stem-volume sampling covariance; simulate sampling errors and biomass; interpolate cycle biomass annually and sum over South/North Finland sampling regions.
appendix_A.figure_A2: NFI13 sampling region 1 mineral-soil biomass 95% intervals, model versus sampling components; graphical, not a numeric national covariance table.
appendix_A.figure_A3: Extreme examples of simulated annual biomass series; not a complete national output or cross-inventory covariance matrix.

target_estimand_assessment.reason: Appendix A is a mineral-soil litter-input uncertainty analysis with illustrative tables. Its algorithm and figures do not deliver a same-domain national above-ground NFI12/NFI13 endpoint covariance matrix.
target_estimand_assessment.feasible_provider_route: Request the existing full A2-A5 inputs and step-7 machine-readable biomass simulations or provider-computed national AGB endpoint/cross-inventory covariance, with domain and estimand confirmed. Exact plot coordinates are not necessary.
do_not_substitute: Finnish volume uncertainty for biomass uncertainty
illustrative matrices for complete national outputs
mineral-soil litter-input uncertainty for national AGB endpoint covariance
